title: AER Offline IOU Promissory Note Schema
description: Cryptographically signed mutual credit promissory note issued in air-gapped or network-partitioned environments for energy or physical replenishment (AER Section 6.3).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

iou_id.description: Unique 32-byte hash identifying this offline promissory note.

debtor_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the debtor rover or machine consuming energy/service.

station_id.description: Ethereum address of the creditor charging station or service kiosk.

energy_kwh.description: Delivered physical electrical energy measured in kilowatt-hours.

unit_price_credit_b.description: Atomic units of Credit B charged per 1 kWh.

total_credit_b.description: Total principal Credit B debt accrued for this charging session.

offline_risk_factor.description: Risk multiplier gamma_offline (>= 1.0) compensating the creditor station for partition latency.

nonce.description: Monotonically increasing sequence counter maintained by the debtor to prevent duplicate clearing.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds when the IOU was signed offline.

expiry_timestamp.description: Deadline timestamp after which the creditor station may submit the IOU for priority netting.

debtor_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature generated by the debtor machine over the canonical IOU hash.
